visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at night on a narrow city street. A person with short black hair wearing a black oversized t-shirt walks toward a small restaurant with a red noren curtain and yellow lantern lighting. (2) Transition to a close-up of a dark ceramic bowl where a thick, creamy white soup is being poured from a metal pitcher, steam rising. (3) A large industrial pot is shown boiling with chicken bones, onions, and carrots in a clear broth that turns opaque. (4) A hand uses a Braun electric immersion blender to emulsify a large vat of yellow-tinted creamy soup. (5) Noodles are transferred from a small red-rimmed bowl into the large main bowl already containing white soup and green onions. (6) Chopsticks lift a large portion of thin, straight ramen noodles, revealing slices of seared meat and green sprouts underneath. (7) Close-ups of a spoonful of creamy soup and various toppings like bamboo shoots, soft-boiled eggs with runny yolks, and marinated tomatoes. (8) A kitchen scene shows a chef in black gloves using a blowtorch to sear slices of pork chashu on a metal wire rack, flames licking the meat. (9) Side dishes are presented on a wooden table, including golden truffle-dusted fries and a piece of deep-fried chicken (karaage) on a small white plate. (10) A male chef with blonde-dyed hair, wearing a black mask and uniform, places a wooden tray with ramen and side dishes onto a counter for a customer. (11) The scene shifts to the restaurant's interior bar featuring rows of backlit sake and liquor bottles, followed by a daytime exterior shot of the shop's white sign and yellow lanterns.
